visual_description: A thick, spiral-bound field notebook with a bright yellow waterproof cover. The cover has a printed scale (ruler) along the edge. The notebook is open to a page showing a hand-drawn sketch of a Triceratops frill with coordinate annotations. A technical 0.5mm mechanical pencil is clipped to the spiral wire.

constraints.material: Matte yellow plastic cover; slightly off-white 'all-weather' paper texture.
constraints.detail: Sketch on the page must look like a professional field drawing, not a cartoon.
